PurismCoreBundle.h is the output of scripts/bundle.sh at that revision. Project note: the header is upstream-generated but we compile it through our own `core.c` in C mode (MSVC rejects two C99 compound literals in C++ mode); the header itself is untouched. It is not Live2D's proprietary Core. No sample viewer, compatibility DLL or test assets shipped from this dependency.
